howBytesWereMeasured.pixels: pdftoppm -r 300 -gray, binary P5 PGM parsed by a reader written for this lane (magic/width/height/maxval tokenizer, then the raw raster). Never -gray -png. Annotations ARE drawn: no -hide-annotations. Ink threshold: a pixel with grey value < 200 is ink. Every raster was held in memory only; every scratch PDF was deleted in the same call and its absence asserted. No raster was retained, published, or looked at by a person.
howBytesWereMeasured.rectBracketing: PUBLISHED IN BOTH CONVENTIONS. A PDF rect is converted to raster space at 300 dpi either by FLOOR on the low edge and CEIL on the high edge, or by ROUND on both. Every checkbox figure in this return is given both ways. FLOOR/CEIL is the convention this lane treats as primary, because it is the one that reproduces VF55's three published Alabama readings simultaneously, and because it is the only one that contains the whole declared rectangle.

howBytesWereMeasured.controlToPrintedLineBinding: pdftotext -bbox on the pinned C-10-CRIMINAL binary, word boxes converted from top-left to PDF space by pageHeight - yMax, then intersected with each control's own row band. howBytesWereMeasured.deliveredBytesStructure: A reader written for this lane: pdf-lib page walk, /Contents inflated with node:zlib, `/<Name> Do` operators matched against /^FlatWidget/ and credited only where that page's own /Resources /XObject dictionary declares the name; annotations counted by /Subtype; AcroForm fields counted by getForm().getFields(). howBytesWereMeasured.verbatimDisclosure: A line-anchored matcher written for this lane in Python: a record string counts as disclosed only when, after NFC normalisation, non-breaking-space folding, whitespace collapse, and stripping a leading '> ', '- ', '* ', 'N. theCONDITIONALCOMPONENT_THISLANESOWNVIEW.theSTRONGESTGROUNDISONEFIX162DIDNOTGIVE: The record puts the affidavit in requiredBeforeFiling. The packet set's own requiredBeforeFiling array names the instrument as something the participant must have done before filing on the branch where it applies, with requiredBeforeFiling true on the underlying action. A packet that withheld the instrument would leave a record entry that the packet itself makes undischargeable: the participant on the indigency branch would be told, by this same guide, to apply for a waiver on a form the packet decided not to give them. Nothing in the manifest or the memo names any circumstance in which the component is omitted. Reading 'required where X' as 'prohibited where not-X' is an inference the record does not license.
theCONDITIONALCOMPONENT_THISLANESOWNVIEW.whereTHISLANEWOULDQUALIFYFIX162: FIX162 writes that withholding the affidavit would assert 'indigency is not claimed' EXACTLY as ticking asserted the opposite. That symmetry is overstated. Not delivering a conditional component is a silence about the condition; ticking a first-person sworn sentence is a statement of it. The two are not equally assertive, and a build is entitled to be silent about a fact it does not hold. The conclusion survives anyway, on the requiredBeforeFiling ground above and on the asymmetry of consequences below -- but the packet's own guide does not rest on the symmetry claim, so nothing delivered depends on it.
theCONDITIONALCOMPONENT_THISLANESOWNVIEW.theASYMMETRYISREALANDMEASURED: The sentence beside Check Box2.2 is first-person and sworn -- this lane read it out of the pinned binary with pdftotext -bbox, not out of a label -- and it sits on a form whose page 10 header prints AFFIDAVIT OF SUBSTANTIAL HARDSHIP AND ORDER, above a signature the packet leaves blank (43 of the 187 refusals are classed signature_or_date_participant_completion). A ticked box is a false sworn financial statement, already filed, that the participant never made. An affidavit filed with no box ticked asks the court for nothing, and the delivered guide now says so in those words. Those failure modes are not symmetric and the recoverable one is the right one to choose.
theCONDITIONALCOMPONENT_THISLANESOWNVIEW.theSIBLINGISTHECONTROL: al-felony-dwop-set carries an identical rules object and an identical fee_waiver component, ships the affidavit in both fixtures with none of the three requests ticked, and VF55 measured that treatment as correct. Bringing al-trafficking-set to it removes a divergence the record never warranted. This lane confirms at the pixel level that the two families now behave identically at all five C-10 page-1 controls.
